context: Daichi gets a small promotion at work; tells Mei excitedly at home.
purpose: Husband sharing career milestone with wife.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.style: Loud, immediate joy breaking through at the opening. Kansai warmth, pride in the announcement. Bright attack, held high. Generous with the good news, no edge.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Small surprised gasp at the start. Immediate pivot to genuine delight. Soft, warm, holding the happiness close — not shouting it back, but felt. Eyes bright.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おう、責任、増えるけどな。
lines.en: Yeah — but the responsibility goes up too.
lines.style: Honest, grounded drop in energy. Kansai warmth still there, but sobering himself. Slower pace on the second half. Not dampening the joy — just being real about the weight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大変かもしれないけど、嬉しい!
lines.en: It'll be hard maybe — but I'm so happy for you.
lines.style: Soft, tender acknowledgment of the difficulty. No minimizing it. Then a gentle swell into the pride — genuine, steady, not loud. Supporting him quietly.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 給料も、ちょっと上がる。
lines.en: And the pay goes up a bit too.
lines.style: Warm, almost matter-of-fact. Kansai ease — comfortable sharing the practical good news. Fond, like he's pleased to tell her this part. Light pace, no performance.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.style: Tender, direct. Soft voice, steady eye contact in the words. No fussiness — just the statement, held. Love underneath, not performing it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: おまえのおかげや、ほんま。
lines.en: It's all because of you — really.
lines.style: Kansai warmth, soft gratitude. Opens with weight — he means it. Slow on 「ほんま」, trailing slightly. Vulnerable in the admission, not covered by jokes.
